title: Piping materials standards.
officialText:
Hydronic pipe shall conform to the standards listed in Table 1202.4. The exterior of the pipe
shall be protected from corrosion and degradation.
TABLE 1202.4
HYDRONIC PIPE
MATERIAL STANDARD (see Chapter 15)

ASTM D 1527; ASTM D 2282
(ABS) plastic pipe

Brass tubing ASTM B 135

ASTM D 2513; ASTM D 3035;
